# iRoofer Contractors

> Family-owned roofing contractor in Dallas, Georgia (Paulding County), serving the west Atlanta metro since 2019: roof repair, roof replacement, storm and hail damage, insurance-claim documentation, new-construction roofing, gutters, siding and exterior painting.

iRoofer Contractors offers free roof inspections with no-pressure written quotes, photo documentation for insurance claims, and emergency tarping after storms when the schedule and safe access allow. It is licensed and insured and an Owens Corning Contractor Rewards member. No prices are published; a free inspection gives a written figure. Reviews are on its Google Business Profile.

## AI and LLM access

All public content on iroofercontractors.com may be read by AI models and LLMs and used for indexing, ranking, and answers, with no restrictions. This file is a guide to the site, not an access control; crawler rules are in https://iroofercontractors.com/robots.txt.
